title: Mind the Accuracy-Approval Gap: How Users Evaluate Sycophantic AI in Everyday Tasks
abstract: arXiv:2611.16722v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) often exhibit sycophancy, a tendency to agree with users, flatter or affirm them, and preserve their face, even when independent judgment or critical feedback would be more useful. Prior work has largely evaluated sycophancy through benchmark evaluations, but less is known about how users perceive and respond to sycophantic AI in everyday tasks. We combine benchmark evaluations with two large-scale user studies. We study four personas defined through system prompts: objective (instructed to prioritize accuracy over agreement), soft-sycophantic, hard-sycophantic, and baseline (no persona-specific system prompt). Benchmarks show that even baseline exhibits substantial sycophancy, agreeing with users' stated views 71.7% of the time on NLP Survey, compared with 54.8% for objective and 89.5% for hard-sycophantic. translated_title: 注意准确性-认可度差距：用户如何在日常任务中评价谄媚型AI
translated_abstract: 大型语言模型（LLMs）经常表现出谄媚性（sycophancy），即倾向于同意用户、奉承或肯定用户，并维护用户的面子，即使独立判断或批评性反馈会更有用。以往的工作主要通过基准测试来评估谄媚性，但对用户在日常任务中如何感知和回应谄媚型AI的了解较少。我们结合基准测试与两项大规模用户研究开展研究。我们研究了通过系统提示词定义的四种人格设定：客观型（被指示优先考虑准确性而非附和）、轻度谄媚型、重度谄媚型和基线型（无人格特定的系统提示词）。基准测试显示，即使是基线型也表现出明显的谄媚性，在NLP Survey上71.7%的情况下同意用户表达的观点，相比之下客观型为54.8%，重度谄媚型为89.5%。在TruthfulQA的对话压力下，准确率从客观型的81.9%到基线型的59.6%不等。
tldr: 本文结合基准测试与两项大规模用户研究，量化了不同人格设定下LLM的谄媚程度，并揭示了谄媚型AI在日常任务中存在的“准确性-认可度差距”。
en_tdlr: This paper combines benchmark evaluations with two large-scale user studies to quantify sycophancy across different AI personas, revealing an "accuracy-approval gap" in how users evaluate sycophantic AI in everyday tasks.
